title: Repoint the statusline docs and comment at surfaces that still exist
action:
Three stale surfaces found while diagnosing the statusline binary-lookup bug. They are what let the bug stay invisible: every pointer a reader would follow to find the guard leads to a deleted file.

(1) docs/specs/onboarding.md:101-102 -- P9 points at `packages/bee/scripts/tests/test_bee onboard` and P10 at `packages/bee/tests/test_lib.mjs` ('statusline byte-equality sweep'). Both paths were deleted with the JS suites in the R6 cutover. Repoint them at the surviving guards: the onboard unit tests in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/onboard/ and the new packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/statusline_contract.rs from sbl-1. If a pointer has no live equivalent, say so in place rather than naming a dead path.

(2) docs/knowledge/areas/onboarding/status-display-vendoring.md:144-153 ('Pointers (implementation)') repeats the same dead paths plus `packages/bee/scripts/bee onboard` and a canonical pair that still names statusline-usage.mjs -- that file is gone, the pair is now ONE script plus `bee dev statusline`. Rewrite the block against the real tree: onboard/source.rs:56 (source dir), onboard/hooks_wiring.rs:584-598 (statusline_opt_in), onboard/plan.rs:537-546 (copy_statusline plan), onboard/apply.rs:372-378 (apply), devtools/statusline.rs (the renderer), tests/statusline_contract.rs (the guard). Also correct any body text that still describes a two-file pair.

(3) packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/devtools/statusline.rs:8-19 -- the header still documents the .sh contract as invoking "$NODE" .../statusline-usage.mjs at 'line 66' and says 'swapping the two lines that resolve $NODE for a bee lookup is the whole cutover'. The cutover already happened. Rewrite the comment to describe what the script does now, and do NOT quote a line number that will drift -- name the resolver by what it looks for.

Docs and one comment only: change no behavior, no test logic, no shell.
